invalid saves and canceled replacement do not change live progress

campaign and Rodin practice use separate selectable local slots without leaking practice money or research
new games reset research after confirmation, while importing a backup restores the previous run
menu and audio settings work at phone width without horizontal overflow

failed resource requests show a retry action, and a retry recovers without a blank screen

displaying an uncommon Chinese character fetches exactly its one extra shard
regular and bold canvas glyphs match the original variable font pixel-for-pixel, including Chinese, digits and a rare character
the offline build embeds WOFF2 shards and loads the complete game charset without a server
failed font downloads fall back to system text without blocking the menu or battle
